title: proto
description: Personal metrics from HealthKit via iOS Shortcuts, stored in VictoriaMetrics on the Linode. Top row is pinned to the current Mon-Su week; everything below follows the time picker.

panels.title: Steps
panels.description: Pinned to now/w -> now (Monday 00:00 through now) via the panel's Relative time override, so the picker below doesn't move it. Days later in the week aren't drawn yet — Grafana has no per-panel 'time to' override, only 'time from'. The x axis is the time field rendered as time:ddd, i.e. the weekday name.

panels.title: Steps to goal
panels.description: 70000 minus the sum of this week's samples. $__range resolves to this panel's own overridden range (now/w -> now), so it is Monday-to-now regardless of the picker. clamp_min holds it at 0 once the goal is met. Deliberately uncoloured: 60K remaining on a Monday is on track, so threshold colours would read as a false alarm all week.

panels.title: Weekly steps
panels.description: One point per Monday-start calendar week, summing that week's days. Done in JS because MetricsQL has no calendar-week bucketing and a [7d] step aligns to Unix epoch multiples (epoch day 0 was a Thursday). The in-progress week is plotted but excluded from the regression fit, so a half-finished week doesn't drag the trend down.

panels.title: Weight (lbs)
panels.description: The `> 0` drops days where HealthKit had no sample and the Shortcut sent 0 — a zero would otherwise crater the axis. Nulls never reach storage; the shim skips them. spanNulls joins across the resulting gaps, since weight is a slow-moving trend where a gap is noise rather than signal.

panels.title: Step calendar
panels.description: GitHub-style contribution grid via Apache ECharts calendar + heatmap. The dedicated calendar-heatmap plugin can't do this: its source has no reference to thresholds or fieldConfig, and colorScheme is a single-hue ramp, so red-below-goal and green-above is impossible there. ECharts visualMap.pieces gives discrete threshold bands instead.
